---
title: "Minneapolis Domestic Assault"
subtitle: "Bayesian spatiotemporal analysis · 2020–2022"
---

```{r setup}
source("03_dashboard.R")
crime <- load_crime_data("data/MPLS_crime.csv")
trend <- compute_annual_trend(crime)
```

## At a Glance

```{r value-boxes}
#| layout-ncol: 3
total_events  <- nrow(crime)
pct_dom       <- round(100 * mean(crime$Y == 1), 1)
years_covered <- paste(range(crime$year), collapse = "–")

bslib::value_box(
  title = "Total assault records",
  value = scales::comma(total_events),
  theme = bslib::value_box_theme(bg = "#1c2233", fg = "#4f8ef7")
)
bslib::value_box(
  title = "Domestic share",
  value = paste0(pct_dom, "%"),
  theme = bslib::value_box_theme(bg = "#1c2233", fg = "#e05c68")
)
bslib::value_box(
  title = "Years",
  value = years_covered,
  theme = bslib::value_box_theme(bg = "#1c2233", fg = "#8892a4")
)
```

## Annual Trend

```{r trend-chart}
#| fig-height: 4
p <- trend |>
  plotly::plot_ly(
    x = ~year, y = ~n, color = ~Offense,
    colors = c("Domestic" = "#e05c68", "Non-Domestic" = "#4f8ef7"),
    type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
    line = list(width = 2), marker = list(size = 7)
  ) |>
  plotly::layout(
    paper_bgcolor = "#131720", plot_bgcolor = "#131720",
    font  = list(color = "#e8eaf6"),
    xaxis = list(title = "Year",   gridcolor = "#2a3147"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Events", gridcolor = "#2a3147"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.15)
  )
p
```

:::{.callout-note}
Data refreshed nightly from the [Minneapolis Open Data portal](https://opendata.minneapolismn.gov).
LGCP model results are pre-computed; see **Model Results** for details.
:::
